passages.provision_quote: without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record
passages.note: Enrolled text bars shielding the education record from parents and requires parental consent to change the record's gender identity, but neither requires notification nor governs staff use of names or pronouns, so it shows the parental side without matching any one rung's object.
Status page shows her as House floor and substitute sponsor of S.B. 100; it prints no provision.
House final passage Yea; 6 of 75 members voted No (under 10%), and the bill's text shows only a side.

rows.reasoning: She was House sponsor of and voted for S.B. 100 (2023), which forbids schools to shield a student's education record from parents and bars changes to the record's gender identity "without written parental consent". That puts her on the parental-involvement side, but the bill neither requires schools to notify parents nor requires parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns (its object is the education record), so it does not separate "tell parents when parents ask", "notify parents" and "parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns".
